title: Cleanup Functions
description: Learn how to clean up side effects to prevent memory leaks.

data.text: Some side effects need cleanup when the component unmounts or before the effect runs again. useEffect can return a cleanup function for this purpose.

data.text: Forgetting to clean up subscriptions, timers, or event listeners can cause memory leaks and unexpected behavior in your application.
